children: Coal India Ltd (CIL) on Sunday said its coal production rose 19.3 per cent year-on-year to 67.2 million tonnes (MT) in October.
The state-owned miner had produced 56.4 MT in the same month last year, according to provisional data filed with the stock exchanges.
Offtake in October stood at 70.3 MT, up 18.7 per cent from 59.2 MT a year ago.

For the April-October period of 2026-27, CIL's production inched up 0.7 per cent to 388.2 MT from 385.5 MT in the year-ago period. Offtake during the seven months grew 9.2 per cent to 454.6 MT from 416.2 MT.

title: Coal India records 19% growth in October production
